key_concepts: Free-body diagrams use arrows to represent forces acting on an object
Arrow length in a free-body diagram indicates force magnitude
Net force is the vector sum of forces acting on an object
Balanced forces produce zero net force
Unbalanced forces produce nonzero net force
Objects with balanced forces may be at rest or moving at constant speed
Objects with unbalanced forces change speed or direction
A falling apple has unbalanced downward force
Friction opposes motion on rough surfaces
A platform balance measures mass when forces are balanced and the pointer is at zero
Tug of war demonstrates balanced and unbalanced forces
Forces to the right or up are positive while forces to the left or down are negative
